MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

2. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 1

3. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 18

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 6

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 31
   D. 27

7. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.025

9. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 17
   C. 11
   D. 12

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 90

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 50

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

13. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 25

17. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 17

18. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

19. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

20. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

21. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 13

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

23. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 11
   C. 28
   D. 29

24. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 0
   C. 64
   D. 65

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
